title: Simplex-constrained machine-learning surrogates for CALPHAD phase-fraction prediction: datasets, predictions, and application artifacts (Fe-based ternaries, Fe-Cr-Ni-C, Fe-Cr-C)
description: Data and result release for a systematic benchmark of simplex-constraint mechanisms (six neural output heads, four classical baselines) for ML surrogates mapping composition and temperature to CALPHAD equilibrium phase fractions. Contains: 7 mass-balance-validated equilibrium datasets (five Fe-based ternaries, 44,397 rows; quaternary Fe-Cr-Ni-C, 13,192 rows; carbide-rich Fe-Cr-C, 13,199 rows; 70,788 total) with probe-active phase sets; per-seed model predictions (NPZ tensors backing the published audit); aggregated result JSONs (heads, baselines, holdout/extrapolation, remedy, ensemble, bootstrap, detection, ablations); trained MLP checkpoints for the application screen; lean-Ni screening and learning-curve artifacts; literature-anchor extraction and evaluation; and the claim-audit ledger. Code: https://github.com/user4072/CALPHAD-based-Phase-Fraction-Prediction. NOTE: the MatCalc mc_fe_v2.062 source database is licensed and NOT redistributed; scripts regenerate the extraction from a local copy.
